field.label: Enabled
field.help: Run juistd on this firewall and have the ruleset call its anchors.

field.label: Port
field.help: UDP port for WireGuard and path discovery.

field.label: Relay
field.help: Let this firewall relay for members that cannot reach each other, once an admin has granted it the relay role.

field.label: Relay port
field.help: TCP and UDP port for relaying.

field.label: Open ports
field.help: Add firewall rules that let juist's ports in on the interfaces below.

field.label: Interfaces
field.help: Interfaces members reach this firewall on, usually WAN.

field.label: Use the public DHT
field.help: Find members and meet invited devices through the public BitTorrent DHT.

field.label: Use public STUN servers
field.help: Ask STUN servers outside the network for this firewall's public address.

field.label: Admin
field.help: Invite and remove devices from the status page, with the admin key in /var/db/juist-admin.
